verdict: Schwab had a record quarter: $190B of new client assets poured in, revenue jumped 17% to $7.17B, and GAAP EPS rose 29% to $1.62.

segments.name: Net interest revenue
segments.note: Interest earned on loans and investments minus interest paid on deposits and borrowing — Schwab's biggest revenue line.

segments.name: Asset management & administration fees
segments.note: Fees for managing client money in funds, ETFs and advisory accounts.

segments.name: Trading revenue
segments.note: Commissions and related revenue from clients trading — daily trades jumped 44%.

segments.name: Bank deposit account fees
segments.note: Fees from the bank deposit account program with partner banks.

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: Industry and service fees and other gains, net of the credit-loss provision on bank loans.

opex.name: Compensation & benefits
opex.note: Pay and benefits for Schwab's roughly 34,000 employees.

opex.name: Professional services
opex.note: Outside consultants, legal and other professional help.

opex.name: Technology, communications & depreciation
opex.note: Communications ($172M), depreciation and amortization ($196M) and amortization of acquired intangibles ($141M).

opex.name: Other expenses
opex.note: Advertising ($114M), regulatory fees ($73M) and other costs ($301M), less the $1M credit-loss provision shown as cost of revenue to avoid double-counting it.

flow.otherDetail: Equity of -$95M is preferred stock dividends and other, deducted after tax: total net income was $2,906M, leaving $2,811M available to common stockholders. Other income is $0 because Schwab reports no separate non-operating line — income before taxes is used as operating income in this adaptation.

takeaways.title: Clients brought in record new money
takeaways.text: Core net new assets hit a record $190.4B, up 38%, and clients opened 1.2 million new brokerage accounts, taking total client assets to $13.33 trillion.

takeaways.title: Every revenue line grew
takeaways.text: Net interest revenue rose 14%, asset management fees 14% and trading revenue 16% as daily average trades jumped 44%.

takeaways.title: Earnings hit a record
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS rose 29% to $1.62. Excluding $151M of pre-tax transaction-related costs, adjusted EPS was $1.69.

oneTimers: $151M of pre-tax transaction-related costs in the quarter, made up of $141M amortization of acquired intangible assets and $10M of acquisition and integration costs. Adjusted net income was $3,021M versus $2,906M GAAP.
footerNote: Financials adaptation: Schwab nets interest expense inside net interest revenue, so cost of revenue is the provision for credit losses on bank loans — $1M in Q3 2026 per the allowance rollforward in the Form 10-Q (the provision is netted inside Schwab's 'other revenue' line, so $1M is backed out of other expenses here to avoid double-counting). Operating income is income before taxes, other income is $0, and preferred dividends are reconciled through equity so net income is the $2,811M available to common stockholders.
